command: python -m pipeline build, after python -m pipeline clean; it failed in Stage 4 at commit 070f35a (see 'failure'); stages 4 to 6 were then run three times with python -m pipeline build --stage 4 on the staged data of the first run, at commits f92a7b3, 0739542 and c442658, each after a correction to the node merge. The artifact is the last run's.
extract_during_clean: moved out of data/ before the clean and back in after it, so Stage 1 read the same file and verified its checksum
failure: The first run (commit 070f35a, from an empty data/) completed stages 1 to 3 and failed in Stage 4's node merge with 'Unknown column geometry': where a surveyed ramp lands on an OSM kerb node whose value differs, the merged row gained a key the other rows lacked, and pandas stacked the groupby result into a Series. The fix (assemble._dedup_nodes, commit f92a7b3) changes only that merge step; stages 1 to 3 are the same code in both commits (git diff 070f35a f92a7b3 touches pipeline/stages/assemble.py and tests/test_v037.py only). The resumed run read the staged files the first run wrote and ran stages 4, 5 and 6; the root's gitSHA is f92a7b3. The second resume changed only how a surveyed ramp's node keeps OSM's kerb values (assemble._merge_node_group): the node carries the survey's values, with OSM's in ext:osm_kerb and ext:osm_tactile_paving whether or not they agree. git diff 070f35a 0739542 touches pipeline/stages/assemble.py, validators/post_build_checks.py, tests/test_v037.py and evaluation/v0.3.7/code/compare_v036.py only; stages 1 to 3 are the same code in all three commits. The third resume corrected the same merge once more: a ramp on no OpenStreetMap vertex is a group of one row, and the second version had copied the ramp's own kerb value into ext:osm_kerb as if OpenStreetMap had tagged it (118,671 ramps carried one in that run's checks). OSM's values now come from the OSM vertex's row only. git diff 070f35a c442658 touches pipeline/stages/assemble.py, validators/post_build_checks.py, tests/test_v037.py and evaluation/v0.3.7/code/compare_v036.py only; stages 1 to 3 are the same code in all four commits.
working_tree_at_build: pipeline/, scripts/, config/, unweaver-project/, tests/ and pyproject.toml as committed; documents and evaluation/v0.3.7/ had uncommitted edits
rehearsal: Before the clean, the whole pipeline (stages 1 to 6) was run once on the v0.3.6 data folders with the v0.3.7 code, at commit 070f35a with the two-pass Stage 1 filter not yet in place, so that run carried no OSM node tags. Its Stage 3 and Stage 4 counts match this build's except where kerb and elevator nodes act: 460 fewer edges carry an incline here (the edges at elevator nodes) and 36 fewer are marked unknown.
